name: Kefnet
aliases: the keeper of the Hekma barrier
description: Kefnet is the ibis-headed God of Knowledge of Amonkhet, one of the gods and caretaker of the Hekma, whose essence was made of the world's corrupted leylines.

description_citations.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary.text: Kefnet is the ibis-headed God of Knowledge of Amonkhet, one of the gods and caretaker of the Hekma, whose essence was made of the world's corrupted leylines.

citations.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Nissa and Chandra resolved to learn what Bolas had changed and to speak with Kefnet, and Nissa found his statue and stepped inside.

citations.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.
"The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Kefnet furiously demanded who mocked his trial, plucked Nissa's thoughts, and offered dissolution as kindness to the unworthy.

citations.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.
"The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Nissa recognized that he was made of corrupted leylines and wove a spell that altered him so he no longer wanted to destroy her, and he declared that she had passed her trial.

citations.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.
"The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

bio.text: The dragon fractured Kefnet's mind in two and he fell, and later the locust god began eating the Hekma.

citations.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.
"Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

bio.text: He tried in vain to repair the Hekma barrier, then fought the scorpion god in tandem with Oketra, who is his sibling.

citations.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

bio.text: The scorpion god reconstituted itself from dust and stabbed him through the forehead, killing him.

citations.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

status.text: Kefnet is dead, killed by the scorpion god in 2017, and a 2026 story recounts Hapatra leaving him to his fate when he would not stand against Razaketh.

citations.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and they resolve to learn what he changed and to speak with Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas must have come and gone only a few decades ago.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Temmet arrives, commanding the mummies, and reveals he checked the birth records and knows the pair are outsiders.
timeline.quote: But I checked the birth records at the Monument of Knowledge,

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa opens her eyes to find a statue of Kefnet, whose doors swing open with blue light, and she steps inside.
timeline.quote: a pair of large limestone doors swung open.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Kefnet appears and furiously demands who mocks his trial.
timeline.quote: It was the god himself, Kefnet.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Kefnet plucks Nissa's thoughts and tells her knowledge is earned, offering dissolution as kindness to the unworthy.
timeline.quote: Dissolution is my kindness for you.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa recognizes that Kefnet is made of corrupted leylines, and weaves a spell that adds a new fiber of mana to them, altering him so he no longer wants to destroy her.
timeline.quote: She pulled it, and added a new fiber of mana to its mix.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Kefnet declares she has passed her trial and flies away.
timeline.quote: You have passed your trial.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa resolves to stop being a pawn, notes the pattern she left in Kefnet, dispels the illusions, and leaves the temple.
timeline.quote: She was tired of being a pawn, constantly reacting to nightmares and failures, never ahead.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon fractures Kefnet's mind in two, and Kefnet falls.
timeline.quote: The dragon tipped his chin and fractured Kefnet's mind in two.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: All five gods gather at the bloody Luxa, but the God-Pharaoh does not arrive.
timeline.quote: The five stood before the crimson shores of the Luxa

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The locust god releases a swarm that begins eating the Hekma, and Oketra recalls the prophecy and declares the Hour of Promise has begun.
timeline.quote: a swarm of locusts poured forth from its hands.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: All the viziers feel a sudden agonizing pain in their chests as Hapatra sees Kefnet take to the air and locusts gather.
timeline.quote: A sudden, jarring pain burst in Hapatra's chest

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: A quarter of the Hekma vanishes and marauding mummies pour into Naktamun while Kefnet tries in vain to repair the barrier.
timeline.quote: a wave of marauding mummies poured into the city from the wastes beyond.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra finds Kefnet and Oketra confronting the scorpion god, and Oketra tells her the gods are there to protect the mortals.
timeline.quote: We are here to protect you

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Kefnet and Oketra fight the scorpion god in tandem, and it grazes Kefnet's wing.
timeline.quote: They moved in tandem with one another

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god reconstitutes itself from dust and stabs Kefnet through the forehead, killing him.
timeline.quote: the beautiful and brilliant Kefnet, God of Knowledge, was dead before he hit the ground.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra leaves Kefnet to his fate when he will not stand against Razaketh.
timeline.quote: Hapatra was a devoted follower of Kefnet, until she saw that he would not stand up against the demon Razaketh and left him to his fate.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Oketra dies facing the Scorpion God as Gideon witnesses; Kefnet falls too.
timeline.quote: When Oketra and Kefnet fell, the two surviving gods turned on each other

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kefnet's Trial of Knowledge: initiates must solve a maze of illusion by recognizing the glyph spell that reveals the true exit.
timeline.quote: A vast labyrinth of water and illusion extended before them.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kefnet inscribes the deeds of each Trial onto temple walls.
timeline.quote: Kefnet inscribes the deeds of each Trial onto temple walls

citation.text: "Hazoret's Monument", section "The Trial of Zeal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After training with Kefnet or his viziers, initiates arrive at the Trial of Knowledge, where Kefnet greets them and dulls their physical instincts.
timeline.quote: Kefnet greets them himself, then casts a spell that dulls their muscle memory and physical instincts

citation.text: "Kefnet's Monument", section "The Trial of Knowledge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Initiates navigate the illusory labyrinth, facing nightmare visions; failures die and are carried out by mummies.
timeline.quote: Initiates encounter spectral creatures shaped by their worst nightmares

citation.text: "Kefnet's Monument", section "The Trial of Knowledge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Initiates who learn the glyph spell find the true exit and are rewarded by Kefnet with their cartouches.
timeline.quote: Kefnet waits to reward them with their cartouches

citation.text: "Kefnet's Monument", section "The Trial of Knowledge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kefnet's viziers who reach the final layers of the Infinite Puzzle glimpse the afterlife and are rewarded with a glorified death.
timeline.quote: Kefnet rewards them with a glorified death

citation.text: "Kefnet's Monument", section "The Infinite Puzzle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Kefnet's trial, Nissa learns to use blue mana.
timeline.quote: Within that trial, she learned not only to trust her instincts but also to utilize her thoughts, making her able to utilize blue mana.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: God-Eternal Kefnet attacks the ritual and Teyo Verada shields the participants until it is completed; Niv-Mizzet is reborn with golden scales and a decagon on his chest.
timeline.quote: Teyo Verada shielded the guild representatives and bystanders long enough for the ritual to be completed.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "Operation Desperation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reborn, Niv-Mizzet incinerates Kefnet and loses consciousness from the strain.
timeline.quote: Upon his rebirth, the Firemind incinerated Kefnet

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "Operation Desperation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral drains the Beacon and blasts off God-Eternal Kefnet's arm with the stored power.
timeline.quote: blasting the god's arm off

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet is resurrected with the Living Guildpact's power and incinerates Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Niv was able to completely incinerate Kefnet in a torrent of flame

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samut, Djeru and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
timeline.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Guildpact Chamber ritual Teyo shields against Kefnet twice, and Niv-Mizzet, resurrected, incinerates Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Teyo managed to create a mighty shield to stop the God-Eternal twice

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet destroys the God-Eternal Kefnet but is left unconscious.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet uses his newfound power to destroy Kefnet

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
